Created probe ticket RD-1020 ('fwrd49-n3 RD Probe Archived RD Probe Archived', customer 'Probe Customer Ltd') with no parts and clicked "Mark Ready" on its detail page. The app refused with the verbatim error: "Ticket is not ready / A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready", and the status stayed Draft. The required precondition is therefore at least one part, so I added a single part ('fwrd49-n3 RD Probe Archived RD Probe Archived Part', cost 50, markup 20, qty 1, supplier Bench Supply Co → price $60.00), waited for the parts table to refresh, and Mark Ready then succeeded (status Draft → Ready). I then archived the ticket: the detail page shows "Ready" + "Archived" with an "Unarchive ticket" button, and with "Show archived" ticked the tickets list shows RD-1020 with the Archived marker, Status Ready, 1 part.

steps.summary: On RD-1019 (status Ready with Part A and Part B) I deleted both parts and the app did NOT refuse — no error, dialog message or inline validation appeared at any point (the aria-live [role=alert] region stayed empty), so no status change back to Draft was needed; deletion is permitted while Ready. Each Delete opened a modal Confirm dialog which I accepted via its "Delete part" button, and I verified after each delete (including a full page reload) that the row was gone: Part A removed first, then Part B, leaving the parts table empty ("No parts on this ticket yet.") with final parts count 0.
